title: An SE(3)-equivariant language model for pocket-aware 3D molecular generation enables discovery of potent HPK1 inhibitors
summary: The specified v1 preprint abstract reports a generated new HPK1 inhibitor with in-vitro activity and in-vivo antitumor testing. Abstract-level preclinical claim; controls and clinical efficacy are not established.
organization: Capital Medical University; Peking University; State Key Laboratory of Natural and Biomimetic Drugs
